test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, which of the following is India’s most populated metropolitan city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mumbai is the center of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 
• Mumbai is the sixth most populous metropolitan area in the world with a population of over 2.3 crores (23 million).
 
• The rapid population growth is attributed to migration from other regions in the country, with migrants seeking business and employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kolkata is the seventh-most populous city in India, with a population of 45 lakh (4.5 million) residents within the city limits.
 
• There is a population of over 1.41 crore (14.1 million) residents in the Kolkata Metropolitan Area.
 
• Bangalore has a population of more than 8 million and a metropolitan population of around 11 million.
 
 
• The third most populous city and fifth most populous urban agglomeration in India.
 
• The largest city in South India, and the 27th largest city in the world.
 
 
 
• Delhi is the fifth most populous city in the world and the largest city in India area-wise, with an estimated 2016 population of 18.6 million
